fusions.name: Nullifying Spike
fusions.desc: Drives a spike of cold iron into an enemy that deals 12 damage, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grey Shrapnel
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone of cold iron filings 5 tiles ahead that deals 28 damage to everything caught, ignoring resistances, with a 50% chance of [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Proof Against Spells
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Grounded Plating
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% arcane resistance.
